lesson_title: Cubes Factorisation: One Mnemonic, Zero Fear
hook_text: SOAP. Four letters that factorise x³ + 8 while your classmates panic.
clip_script: And the signs obey one mnemonic: SOAP. Same — Opposite — Always Positive. The first bracket's sign is the same as the original expression. The second bracket's middle sign is the opposite of the original. The second bracket's last sign is always positive. Run SOAP on the sum: a cubed plus b cubed. Same: a plus b. Opposite: minus a b. Always positive: plus b squared. Exactly the identity. Both identities, one mnemonic, zero memory strain.
visual_style: Soap-bar letters S-O-A-P stamping signs onto a growing factorisation, bubbles popping as the middle terms cancel in the verification.
pacing: Punchy letter-by-letter rhythm, quick worked example, clean landing.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and factorise x³ + 8 in under a minute.
